activation: Shared contract only. No route, worker, migration or CLI is activated by this batch; activation changes land with the owning service implementation batch.

retention.applies_to: Sessions whose durable state is deleted
retention.disabled: a retention of 0 disables automated purge; operator erasure remains available through the CLI

purge_scope.automated_removes: only deleted Sessions and their Session-owned content, including derived learning records inside the selected scope
automated_never_removes: closed Sessions that are not deleted
Run history of Sessions that are not deleted

worker.ownership: the existing legacy worker lock, or the immutable per-Agent generation fence in peer mode
worker.blocked_disposition: blocked work is skipped and reported, never counted as cleanup success
worker.scan_progress: bounded scans continue past blocked rows without starvation

selector_semantics.--organization: all Session principals of the organization

cli.scope_limit: Session content and its derived learning records only; never arbitrary external Identity, Controller, Runtime or Registry deletion
cli.retention_override: explicit confirmed erasure includes active, closed and deleted Sessions without grace-period delay; quiescence and cleanup guards still apply
cli.lock: the exclusive existing ACP worker lock
cli.live_acp: refused, including peer or shared lock holders
cli.dry_run: requires the same lock and only reports bounded-batch counts
cli.confirm: required for deletion and rejected together with --dry-run

exit.blocked_counts: reported with a nonzero incomplete result

published_skill.artifact: remains readable and re-publishable after its source Session is purged

retained_records.budget_accounting: retained rows and unknown charges are never reduced or turned into zero
retained_records.documentation: table documentation identifies the intentional metadata and derived-record exceptions
